title: Associate Software Quality Assurance Engineer
highlights: Delivered end-to-end software quality assurance across CRM, SaaS, AI-powered, and web applications (DealerIQ AI, Befer AI, Leadly.ai, Broker OS, StephanAI) ensuring stable, user-ready product releases.
Designed and maintained test cases, test scenarios, test plans, QA status reports, defect reports, and regression suites based on business requirements and user workflows.
Validated critical business workflows including lead pipelines, appointment scheduling, AI voice calls, AI chats, paperwork, shipment navigation, forms, filters, and role-based permissions.
Reported and tracked defects in Jira and ClickUp with granular reproduction steps, DevTools logs, severity/priority ratings, and business impact assessments.
Collaborated with developers and stakeholders to verify fixes, clarify requirements, conduct impact analyses, and eliminate production regressions.

title: Software Quality Assurance Engineer (Intern)
highlights: Completed hands-on SQA training covering SDLC, STLC, QA/QC, manual testing, functional, regression, smoke, and exploratory testing.
Designed and executed test cases and test plans using Boundary Value Analysis (BVA), Equivalence Partitioning (EP), Decision Tables, and Use Case Testing.
Practiced bug reporting, defect lifecycle management, severity/priority analysis, SQL database validation, and Jira-based defect management.
Gained practical exposure to REST API testing with Postman, HTTP methods, and backend workflow validation.
